source: SEFE Energy Market Insights via the PowerKlock warehouse (analytics.forward_curve, tenors Y+1 / Y+2, mean of daily closes over the trading year); spot: ENTSO-E day-ahead (analytics.da_price_daily, base); TRVE 2026 Cal average: CRE deliberation 2026-06
query: select market, tenor, extract(year from trade_date) ty, avg(value_eur) from analytics.forward_curve where market in ('FR','DE') and tenor in ('Y+1','Y+2') group by 1,2,3
note: Cal for delivery Y traded during Y-1 (Y+1) and Y-2 (Y+2); 2027 traded 2 Jan - 29 Oct 2026; 2026 spot = Jan-Oct; Y+2 for 2024 traded Sept-Dec 2022 only
